shared_character_prompt: Individual square transparent game card illustration. Preserve the exact character identity, outfit, weapon and colors of assets/front/<ID>.png. Flat cartoon with thick dark brown #3B2A20 outlines, simple flat colors and one cel shadow step. Entire character in three-quarter front view, centered, all weapons and headwear inside square, no separate black pedestal, no card border, text or scenery. True RGBA transparency.
